page.overview:
What is Morgana?

The Morgana was a starship that went missing after entering hyperspace fifty cycles before 3 ABY. A human smuggler claim to have seen the Morgana in the Sayma Nebula while talking with an associate at a cantina in the nearby space station Hauler's Keep.

A thief named Kay Vess overheard this conversation and later recovered old galactic credits from a container near where the smuggler claimed to have seen the Morgana.

The Morgana was first mentioned in the "A Pirate's Fortune" expansion for the Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws, It was mentioned as part of an ambient conversation that players can listen to to start the "Ghost Ship" intel quest.
